expectedResult: The Add New Rule form opens showing Report ID, Rule Description, Category, Severity, Status, Frequency, Risk Score, date fields, and Save Changes and Cancel actions.

taskDescription: Verify that Report ID is auto-generated when creating a new rule. Auto-generation prevents duplicate manual identifiers.
expectedResult: Report ID is auto-generated and displayed in a read-only or pre-filled state.

taskDescription: Verify that a user can complete the Add New Rule form with all fields and submit it successfully. End-to-end rule creation adds a new scheduled MIS report to the catalog.
expectedResult: The report rule is saved successfully and the new entry is visible in the catalog with the configured values.

taskDescription: Verify that Cancel closes the configuration form without saving changes. Cancel protects users from accidental partial submissions.
expectedResult: The form closes without saving and previously entered values are not retained.

taskDescription: Verify that Rule Description is mandatory when saving a report rule. Mandatory description text supports audit identification of report purpose.
expectedResult: Save is blocked and a validation message indicates Rule Description is required.

taskDescription: Verify that Risk Score accepts only values within configured boundaries. Boundary enforcement prevents invalid risk thresholds in reporting rules.
expectedResult: Invalid Risk Score input is rejected with appropriate validation feedback.

taskDescription: Verify that From Date cannot be later than To Date when saving a rule. Valid date ranges ensure meaningful report periods.
expectedResult: Save is blocked and a date range validation message is displayed.

taskDescription: Verify that Daily, Weekly, and Monthly frequency options are available. Frequency options must match operational scheduling needs.
expectedResult: Daily, Weekly, and Monthly frequency options are listed.

taskDescription: Verify that an existing report rule can be edited and saved. Edit capability supports ongoing maintenance of MIS schedules.
expectedResult: Updated configuration values are saved and displayed when the rule is reopened.

taskDescription: Verify that saved rule configuration values persist after reopening the form. Data persistence ensures reporting continuity across sessions.
expectedResult: All saved configuration values including frequency, status, and dates are retained.

taskDescription: Verify that consecutive new rules receive unique Report IDs. Unique identifiers prevent catalog collisions and audit confusion.
expectedResult: Each saved rule receives a unique Report ID.

taskDescription: Verify that Report ID format follows the configured MIS naming pattern. Consistent identifiers support integration and audit searches.
expectedResult: Report ID follows the configured Sanctions MIS report naming pattern with a standard prefix and numeric sequence.

taskDescription: Verify that generating a report without required backend data shows a controlled message. Controlled failures prevent silent data gaps in compliance reporting.
expectedResult: A clear message indicates generation could not complete and the application remains stable.

taskDescription: Verify that searching detail records with no matches shows an empty grid message. Empty search results must be distinguishable from system failure.
expectedResult: No matching records are displayed and an appropriate empty state message appears.

taskDescription: Verify that export with no available records is handled gracefully. Export failures must not corrupt application state.
expectedResult: Export is blocked or a clear no-data message is shown without application errors.

taskDescription: Verify that invalid date entry in report rule configuration is rejected. Invalid scheduling dates must not create incorrect MIS runs.
expectedResult: Invalid date input is rejected and the rule is not saved.

taskDescription: Verify that same-day From and To dates are accepted for single-day MIS analysis. Same-day reporting supports ad hoc investigation requests.
expectedResult: Same-day range is applied successfully and results load for that day.

taskDescription: Verify that leap year dates are accepted in date filters and configuration. Date controls must handle February 29 correctly.
expectedResult: Leap year date is accepted without validation errors.

taskDescription: Verify that large report datasets paginate without performance degradation on the first page load. Responsiveness is required for high-volume screening environments.
expectedResult: Report sections load within acceptable time and pagination navigates successfully.

taskDescription: Verify that special characters in detail search do not cause application errors. Robust search handling protects system stability during analyst investigations.
expectedResult: Application remains stable and returns no matches or safe results without errors.

taskDescription: Verify that SQL injection patterns in search fields are handled safely. Input sanitization protects backend screening data stores.
expectedResult: Search input is sanitized and no unauthorized data exposure or errors occur.

taskDescription: Verify that script injection in Rule Description is rejected or escaped on save. Configuration forms must prevent stored cross-site scripting risk.
expectedResult: Script content is rejected or safely escaped and does not execute in the application.

taskDescription: Verify that export options remain available after applying report filters. Analysts must be able to export the same scoped view they reviewed on screen.
expectedResult: Export actions remain available after filters are applied.

taskDescription: Verify that report pages remain stable when no records exist for the selected period. Empty reports should still render headers and guidance sections.
expectedResult: Report layout remains intact with zero records and no error messages.

taskDescription: Verify that unauthorized users cannot access report configuration actions. Role-based restrictions protect MIS rule integrity.
expectedResult: Configuration or generation actions are disabled or access denied for unauthorized users.

taskDescription: Verify that create, modify, generate, and export actions are recorded in the audit trail with user and timestamp. Audit logging supports regulatory examinations.
expectedResult: Audit trail entries exist for MIS report generation and export with user attribution and timestamps.
